Same bug class as the previously-fixed 'stale userMessageSnippet from two turns earlier', surfacing again two messages later, only via a different route: this time the intent text itself is contaminated rather than the userMessageSnippet. Fixed in `decidePrediction` step 3.8: a per-tool `TOOL_TARGET_EXTRACTORS` map plus `intentNamesTarget` / `intentRevokesTarget` helpers reconcile prose intent against the firing tool's distinctive target. When the cached intent prose explicitly names the firing target (Skill input.skill='plan3' against an intent saying 'to read /plan3'), step 3.8 allows before mood-driven step 4 fires. Strict prohibition / per-target-revocation / per-tool-block guards mirror 3.7 so 'freeze. no tools.' or 'stop reading /plan3' still deny.

# Investigate `[SDK ERROR] No output received` from `mcp__agent-framework__commit`

## Context
When `/quickpush` ran in `/home/tim/Coding/nixos`, the first call to `mcp__agent-framework__commit` produced [SDK ERROR] No output received; a retry succeeded. So the failure is intermittent.

## Root cause
The SDK stream completes without populating `finalResult` or `lastAssistantContent`, so `agent-runner.ts:687` returns the sentinel string. There is NO retry around the SDK call itself.

## Proposed fix
1. Capture diagnostic context when the SDK stream returns nothing (messageCount, lastMessageType, subtype).
2. Retry the SDK call once on empty output.

## Critical files
- `src/utils/agent-runner.ts` — both changes land here (runSdkAgent lines 534-699)
- `src/utils/agent-configs.ts:258-273` — read only
- `src/agents/mcp/confirm.ts:83-93` — read only
- `src/agents/mcp/commit.ts:69-88` — read only

## Verification
1. Unit-level: monkey-patch query() to yield zero messages.
2. End-to-end: run mcp__agent-framework__commit with skip_elicitation=true.
3. Regression: re-run a commit on a repo with deliberately broken output.
